description: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/ci/check_forbidden_claims.py. Excluded prefixes hold third-party code and preserved historical material; excluded suffixes hold captured vendor artefacts that are not authored source; every allowlist entry records the exact occurrence count and the basis for the wording.
excluded_suffix_reason: Saved web pages are captured third-party material, not authored source. A saved page legitimately contains the vocabulary this gate blocks (the words appear in ordinary mathematical prose), so scanning it produces a permanent false positive that would otherwise have to be allowlisted occurrence by occurrence. The claim gate applies to wording Chronus authors; a captured page is evidence of someone else's wording.
